packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/objc-receipt-clang/version and components/objc-reference-clang/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest, so the Linux job fails on a bump until the linux-sha256 beside components/objc-receipt-clang names the new release's archive. components/objc-reference-clang has no linux-sha256, by design, and needs none.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, rewrite the linux-sha256 beside components/objc-receipt-clang (components/objc-reference-clang needs none) with the `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/objc-receipt-clang/linux-sha256`. An objc-receipt-clang bump must also pass tests/objc-source-inventory-host-test.sh on Linux and a Mac.
